clue.text: Hollow and dry instruction to dog the German PM

parts.note: a hollow in the ground is a pit
TT, teetotal, means not drinking: dry
heel is the command telling a dog to walk close by
der is a German word for 'the'

explanation.surface: A deadpan description of some politician's brusque, dog-training manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hollow and dry' reads as a description of a speech, but each word gives letters. William Pitt the Elder was an 18th-century British Prime Minister, father of Pitt the Younger.
explanation.definitionFit: He served as Britain's Prime Minister in the 1760s, so a PM is exactly what he was.

clue.text: Secretary on job release

parts.note: PA, personal assistant, is a secretary
a role is a job or position

explanation.surface: A secretary is released early on account of their work.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole is the conditional early release of a prisoner.

clue.text: Tails partner that takes in work

indicators.note: the word that swallows the work letters, holding them inside itself

parts.note: taken as written
OP, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Reads like a puzzle about something that pairs with tails and absorbs work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tails' here is the formal tailcoat, not the side of a coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal evening dress of tails is traditionally worn with a tall silk hat, its natural partner.

clue.text: Suit(e) trio

definitions.meaning: a matching jacket, trousers and waistcoat, or a sofa with two armchairs
a group of three items or players

explanation.walkthrough: The bracketed E lets one word serve two senses: a three-part suit of clothes and a three-part suite of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Something made of three parts, like a set of three chairs or a waistcoat outfit, is described this way.

clue.text: Stops, doesn't start and relaxes

indicators.note: the synonym for stops loses its opening letter

parts.note: ceases means stops

explanation.surface: Someone who stops, never gets going, and takes it easy.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease off is to relax or slacken, so these are synonyms.

clue.text: Celebrity embraced by poor love child

indicators.note: the celebrity is held inside the word for poor

parts.note: bad means poor in quality
a star is a celebrity

explanation.surface: A tabloid tale of a star hugged by someone poor, and a secret child.
explanation.definitionFit: A love child is one born outside marriage, which the old word for an illegitimate child also names.

clue.text: At last, green tailless lizard found in bath coming up for a nibble

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming up means the letters read from bottom to top
the green letter and the cut lizard sit inside the bath word

parts.note: a tub is a bath

indicators.note: only the final letter of green is used
the lizard loses its tail, its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before losing its end

explanation.surface: A lizard turns up in the bath while somebody snacks on something green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found in' puts N and LIZAR inside TUB, giving TUNLIZARB, which 'coming up' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: This large South American nut is something you might nibble, so it is an example of a nibble.

clue.text: See 24
Many ogle vicar, one stripped in church

indicators.note: each of the four words has its outer letters peeled away, leaving its insides

explanation.surface: A vicar is ogled by a crowd while somebody undresses in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripped' looks like undressing but removes the first and last letter of Many, ogle, vicar and one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Church of England is the Anglican church, so the word stands for that church.

clue.text: Had the temerity to acquire knowledge and became dim!

indicators.note: the word for had the temerity takes in the knowledge word

parts.note: dared means had the nerve
ken is range of knowledge

explanation.surface: Someone bold enough to learn things, and grew duller for it.
explanation.walkthrough: KEN is an old Scottish word for knowledge, as in 'beyond my ken'.
explanation.definitionFit: To grow dark is to dim, so the past form means grew dim.

clue.text: More mature half-hearted serial killer

indicators.note: the doubled letter at the heart of the killer's name loses one of its pair

parts.note: Jack the Ripper was a notorious serial killer

explanation.surface: An older murderer who has lost some enthusiasm.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of RIPPER is PP; halving it leaves one P.
explanation.definitionFit: Riper fruit is further along in maturity, so this comparative means more mature.

clue.text: One gathers second coming starts with Nemesis

indicators.note: just the opening letter of coming is used

parts.note: Nemesis was the Greek goddess of retribution, an avenger

explanation.surface: Someone collects things while a second coming begins with retribution.
explanation.definitionFit: A scavenger is a creature or person who gathers what others leave behind.

clue.text: Left perished in disarray, having accepted Theresa's final command

indicators.note: the scrambled letters take in the final letter
the letters of perished are thrown into a new order
only the last letter of Theresa is used

explanation.surface: A political story of the Left collapsing while Theresa May hangs on to power.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's in Theresa's just links her to her final letter A.
explanation.definitionFit: Command in the sense of being in charge of others is the role of leading them.

clue.text: Opinion polls ease off and make things worse

indicators.note: the letters of the three words go off, as in spoilt, and come back reordered

explanation.surface: A news line about falling poll ratings worsening a politician's plight.
explanation.walkthrough: Pelion and Ossa are Greek mountains; in myth giants piled one on the other, so the phrase means adding difficulty to difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes heaping one trouble on top of another, which makes a bad situation worse.

clue.text: Convenience of Western warnings on Arab uprising

parts.note: omens are warnings of things to come

indicators.note: in a down entry, the word for Arab reads bottom to top

parts.note: a Moor is a North African Arab

explanation.surface: Western nations hear warnings of an Arab uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convenience' is the British euphemism for a public toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: A public toilet is a convenience, and one for ladies is this kind of room.

clue.text: Miserable record playing into the small hours

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
on means playing, as a show is on
so late means well past midnight

explanation.surface: Someone is unhappy because a neighbour's record keeps playing after midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone disconsolate cannot be comforted, which is to be thoroughly miserable.

clue.text: Essentially, copper is outside entrance to Room 101 with partner

indicators.note: the copper letters sit around the first letter of room

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: the first letter of Room is the way in

parts.note: CI is 101 in Roman numerals
an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: A policeman stands outside Room 101, Orwell's torture chamber, with a colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' looks like a police officer but is the metal; Room 101 is the torture room in Orwell's novel Nineteen Eighty-Four.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something matters crucially means it is essential, so the adverbs share that sense.

clue.text: Quiet entering tortuous path, hit and attacked — too late!

indicators.note: the quiet letters go into the scrambled letters
a tortuous path twists, so the letters of path and hit are twisted

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
assailed means attacked

explanation.surface: A hushed, winding path where someone was hit and attacked, but help came too late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts SH into THATIPH, the anagram of PATH and HIT, giving THATSHIPH.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom says an opportunity has passed, which is what too late means as an exclamation.

clue.text: Divine food in Asia: my best restaurant's oriental starters

indicators.note: the starters are placed inside the word Asia
the opening letters of the four words are taken

explanation.surface: A diner boasts that their favourite Asian restaurant serves heavenly starters.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth ambrosia was the food of the gods, so it is divine food.

clue.text: Infirm relatives abandoning a region of England

parts.note: split as 'in firm': in means at home, and firm gives CO, short for company

indicators.note: the relatives word drops the letter a

parts.note: aunties are relatives

explanation.surface: Sick family members are left behind somewhere in England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Infirm' must be read as two words, IN (HOME) and FIRM (CO). The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London.
explanation.definitionFit: The group of counties ringing London forms a recognised region in the south-east of England.

clue.text: See 12
See 12
Novice found in empty room

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the phrase empty room, across the word break

explanation.surface: A beginner is discovered in a vacant room.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyro is a beginner or learner, a synonym of novice.

clue.text: Film maker genius, about 18

indicators.note: the genius's name goes about, around, the letters from 18

parts.note: Albert Einstein is the archetypal genius
the answer to 18 across is the region round London, which lies in the south-east, SE

explanation.surface: A clever film director is said to be about eighteen.
explanation.walkthrough: '18' looks like an age but points to the answer at 18 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Eisenstein was the Soviet director of Battleship Potemkin, a famous film maker.

clue.text: See 1 across
Rogan josh balm?

parts.note: these four letters are the meat of a young sheep, cooked up, or jumbled, in the pot

explanation.surface: A cheeky question whether a curry could be used as ointment.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as an instruction: the meat word, stewed, gives balm. Rogan josh is a lamb curry from Kashmir.
explanation.definitionFit: Rogan josh is a slow-cooked curry of mutton or young sheep, so it is an example of this dish.

clue.text: See 16
Is sick after five cancelled bypasses

indicators.note: the five letter is removed from the sick word

parts.note: vomits means is sick
V is five in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone is ill after five events were called off.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something out is to skip or pass over it, so bypasses works as a synonym.

clue.text: Strategy is to cross from the East by a philanderer

indicators.note: the strategy word is crossed through by the other letters, which go inside it

parts.note: a ploy is a strategy

indicators.note: in an across entry, read from the east means right to left

explanation.surface: A womaniser's strategy is to come over from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the East' turns BY A into AYB, which goes into PLOY.
explanation.definitionFit: A playboy chases pleasure and women, which is what a philanderer does.

clue.text: Country in the centre of Europe madness

indicators.note: the middle two letters of Europe are taken

parts.note: mania is madness

explanation.surface: A country gripped by madness at the heart of Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: This Balkan nation is one of the countries of eastern Europe.
